systems.system: National Solidarity sector digital services platform
systems.country_label: unified digital platform of the National Solidarity sector, integrated into the national digital services portal
systems.owner: Ministry of National Solidarity, Family and the Status of Women, with the High Commission for Digitalisation
systems.tiers: pilot until 31 March 2026 at the two pilot municipalities of Dar El Beida and Hussein Dey; electronic registration for the Lump Sum Solidarity Allowance (AFS) and the digital card for persons with special needs

note: A ministry's own service platform on trial in two Algiers municipalities; the article does not say the communes' offices are connected or that commune staff work in it, so no fact on the office connection.
